name: Macarons (Puducherry Style)
ingredients: Puducherry-grown cardamom powder (for a local twist)
instructions: 1. Sift the almond flour and powdered sugar together twice to ensure a fine texture. 2. Whip the egg whites with a pinch of salt until frothy, gradually adding granulated sugar until stiff peaks form. 3. Fold the dry ingredients into the meringue gently until the mixture reaches a lava-like consistency. 4. Fold in a pinch of finely ground local cardamom for the signature Puducherry aromatic profile. 5. Pipe small rounds onto a baking sheet and let them rest for 30 minutes to develop a skin. 6. Bake at 150°C for 12-15 minutes until feet appear. 7. Cool completely before filling with buttercream or ganache.
description: Introduced by the French during their colonial rule in Puducherry, the macaron has become a symbol of the town's 'French Quarter' culture. Local pastry chefs often integrate traditional Indian aromatics like cardamom or saffron into these delicate almond cookies, blending European pastry techniques with the flavor profile of the subcontinent.
